```{python}
import polars as pl

basics = pl.scan_csv("title.basics0.tsv.gz", separator="\t", null_values=r"\N")
review = pl.scan_csv("title.ratings.tsv.gz", separator="\t", null_values=r"\N")
principal = pl.scan_csv("title.principals0.tsv.gz", separator="\t", null_values=r"\N")
```

```{python}
#Criando as tabelas:
tabela1 = basics.join(review, on="tconst", how="inner")

```

1. 
```{python}
# 5 Filmes com maior média (questão 1):
maiores_media = (
    tabela1
    .sort(["averageRating", "numVotes"], descending=True)
    .select(["primaryTitle", "averageRating"])
    .head(5)
    .collect()
)
maiores_media
```

2. 

```{python}
bygenre = (
    tabela1
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 8)
    .group_by("genres")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("n"))
    .sort("n", descending=True)
    .head(10)
    .collect()
)
bygenre

```

3. 
```{python}
review_reduzido = (
    review.select(["tconst", "averageRating"])
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5)
)
principal_reduzido = (
    principal
    .select(["tconst", "nconst", "category"])
)

tabela2 = review_reduzido.join(principal_reduzido, on="tconst", how="inner")

byprincipals = (
    tabela2
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5)
    .group_by("nconst")
    .agg(pl.len().alias("n"))
    .sort("n", descending=True)
    .head(3)
    .collect()
)
byprincipals
```
